title: Extract fieldwork::relay module
description:
ActivityPub relay subscription management. ~277 lines in BS relay.rs, similar in GJ/SH.

Source: BS relay.rs (cleanest separation from server logic).

Public API:
- build_relay_follow(actor_uri: &str, relay_uri: &str, follow_id: &str) -> serde_json::Value — construct Follow activity for relay subscription
- build_relay_unfollow(actor_uri: &str, relay_uri: &str, original_follow: &serde_json::Value, undo_id: &str) -> serde_json::Value — construct Undo{Follow} for relay removal
- validate_relay_url(url: &url::Url) -> Result<(), Error> — HTTPS + SSRF check on relay URL
- fetch_relay_inbox(client: &reqwest::Client, relay_url: &str) -> Result<String> — fetch relay actor document, extract inbox URI

What stays in consumers: DB storage of relay subscriptions (pending/active/rejected status), CLI commands for add/remove/list, activation on Accept receipt.

Deps: serde_json, reqwest, ssrf-guard, url.

Note: Depends on fieldwork::activities for Follow/Undo construction once that module exists. Consider making relay use activities::build_follow/build_undo internally.
close_reason: All 3 final extractions done. relay (10 tests), actor_cache (9 tests), profile (6 tests). 177 total fieldwork tests pass.
